description: Perímetro do Porto Digital is a dataset listed in City of Recife open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaria de Política Urbana e Licenciamento. Contém dados referentes a região instituída por Lei contido no programa de incentivo ao Porto Digital mediante a concessão de benefícios fiscais aos estabelecimentos, contribuintes do Imposto Sobre Serviço de Qualquer Natureza - ISSQN, situados no âmbito de Revitalização da Zona Especial do Patrimônio Histórico Cultural 09 - Sítio Histórico do Bairro do Recife (Zona ... Coverage: Recife. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaria de Política Urbana e Licenciamento. Its tags are benefício, benefício fiscal, concessão fiscal, fiscal, incentivo. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, JSON. The portal shows 2026-03-04 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-recife-portal.
